decisions.reason: The burner component builds directly on the firm's core radiant-heater know-how and its in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret results and refine it, although its low website visibility adds slight uncertainty.
The electric infrared panel heater extends the established infrared offer, is presented on a page of its own, and fits the firm's shift toward lower-carbon heating, which its own R&D can support.
The halogen infrared heater sits within the firm's existing radiant-heating knowledge base and has a dedicated page, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it.
The industrial electric hall heater is close to the firm's core hall-heating business and serves its existing customers, so it benefits from strong related knowledge and the service network.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is a strategic, R&D-backed extension of the core gas radiant line, already in real operation, and matches the firm's stated move toward hydrogen-ready systems.
